scores.visual_critic_note: Intentional Paul Tol palette and KDE diagonal elevate it above generic, but the legend is crammed at the very bottom edge and typographic hierarchy is minimal, keeping it from feeling truly designed.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Honest encoding throughout: data-driven domains via d3.extent, correct zero-baseline KDE areas (y0 maps to density=0), principled Silverman bandwidth per species, fixed-radius scatter points (no lie factor), and consistent flipped y-scales across scatter/grid; no key functions needed since data joins are static.
scores.stress_test_note: The brush 'brush' event recomputes KDE for all 4 diagonal cells and mutates fill-opacity on ~2400 circle elements on every mousemove with no debouncing, requestAnimationFrame, or dirty-flag coalescing, and no .filter() guard against touch/mouse double-firing.
scores.cognitive_load_note: 16-cell SPLOM reads as one conceptual unit with a clean 3-color palette and diagonal KDE panels that break up the grid; brush propagates across 15 targets simultaneously which is manageable, but 150px cells with ~200 overlapping points per scatter panel (especially sepal dimensions) push toward the legible minimum for point discrimination.
